scientific_scope_status: Preserve the expected subgroup-image bound under strict triangular layers and the stated shared-category/uniform-mask independence premise, plus the exact HNF/local callable prototype for cyclic Z/MZ. The implementation is cyclic only. N610 base-p digit inclusion is proved for prime-power moduli only; mixed-prime CRT needs joint categories and cross-component forcing, and generic finite-group access does not establish polynomial bit cost. In the matched root 3,000-draw Z/4 run, subgroup HNF used 5.760 fresh events and 3.195 s versus 7.013 events and 0.405 s for the digit incumbent. Fewer random events did not win on total measured time. No new output class or practical advantage is established.
